checks.finding: The supplied level conditions preserve an adelically transported full global lattice. The argument concerns the original class representative and original level subgroup.

At either auxiliary prime, rank_eq_first_level makes the entire reduction upper unipotent. A prime-to-p torsion matrix congruent to 1 has first nonzero valuation term n*pi^a*C in its nth power, contradiction because n is a unit; the separated case is the identity. Upper-unipotent reduction has p-power order. Injectivity of each local split realization therefore makes the original order simultaneously a g0-power and a g1-power, hence 1. The exact stabI_inj/range fields identify the stored stabilizers, and their original weights become 1.

The added piU_cong and piU_norm calculation proves T is distinct from both auxiliary primes by reducing pi*conj(pi)=T at a prime over g_i. The residue field of order T is the prime field; the lifted root b of X^2-alpha^2 has unit derivative 2b. Newton lifting yields a unit square root and integral complementary conjugate idempotents. No independent splitting hypothesis is silently inserted.

The quotient is a module of additive prime order, so an idempotent acts by zero or identity. The chosen scalar k^(-1)e+k(1-e) and its inverse are integral, have norm 1, preserve both original local lattices, and give the required multiplier. Outside the selected place the element is 1; in particular it is 1 at both auxiliary primes. Conjugation preserves the original level stabilizer, and the (T-1)st power is in the level subgroup. The original fv0/val0 fields identify these elements with the stored class and form actions.

A fixed double coset gives y^(-1)*gamma*y in U*delta^(-1). Since delta normalizes U and delta^(T-1) belongs to U, gamma^(T-1) is an original stabilizer and is 1 by RSL7. The now-finite-order gamma has upper-unipotent reduction at the two auxiliary primes, forcing gamma=1. Nonzero level functionals then force every multiplier to be 1.

Choosing one representative in each free orbit gives the displayed slice; unique supports prove injectivity of Psi and restrictions followed by inverse translations give its explicit inverse.
